candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Frontend Engineer, Design System Team

## Experience

- Frontend engineer on the design system team of a software company for three years, implementing twenty-six components against the product designers' specifications under the library's contribution standard.
- Wrote the accessibility tests and the visual regression tests for each component, with the test results attached to each component's pull request and checked by the accessibility specialist.
- Reviewed the product teams' contributions to the library as one of the team's three reviewers; the release approval for each library version was the design system lead's, recorded in the release record.
- Supported the product teams' adoption of new components through the adoption office hours and the migration guides, recording in the adoption log which migrations I did and which the product teams did themselves.
- Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each library release in the release record.

## Work samples

- Work sample: three component pull requests with their test results and review records, one release record with its limitation note, and the adoption log for one quarter, with the repository references as a verification trail.
